newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing
prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose sharply to 3.792 billion yuan from 961 million yuan with the seven-day contract the most actively traded.
Traders said turnover surged with both banks and non-banking financial institutions trading actively mainly because Friday was the quarterly settlement day for them.
Non-banking financial institutions including the securities houses, who trade through the short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, also borrowed heavily, they said.

Traders said the short-term market trend was unclear mainly due to Beijing's recent crackdown on the financial markets and renewed market rumours of a possible cut in the bank reserve ratios shortly. Officials have declined to comment.
